cases.content: 您好，欢迎使用莫小派AI工作台！我们提供最先进的销售知识管理和SOP自动化解决方案。通过我们的平台，您的销售团队可以快速获取产品知识、标准作业流程和客户案例，大幅提升销售效率和成单率。立即体验，开启智能销售新时代！

cases.name: english_prose
cases.content: The context budget system is designed to manage token usage efficiently across large language model calls. By estimating token counts before making API requests, the system can proactively compress or truncate context fragments when the estimated total exceeds the safe input budget threshold. This prevents context overflow errors and reduces unnecessary API costs.
cases.notes: Pure English: ~340 chars * 0.25 t/c ≈ 85 tokens + overhead
